observations: Metallic industrial coupling with a central bore and six mounting lugs.
The top face is stamped with 'F80', 'F80H', '2012', and 'FENAFLEX'.
The coupling shows significant surface wear, scratches, and some discoloration.
The item is resting on a tiled floor.

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage to the elastomeric joint.
risks.proof: A video showing the coupling being rotated to inspect the inner surface.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged internal joint

risks.risk: The coupling may be seized or have seized mounting lugs.
risks.proof: A video showing the lugs being turned by hand.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the coupling being rotated to check the internal joint condition.
Video showing the mounting lugs being turned to confirm they are not seized.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by the brand and model stamped on the top face. It can be priced at its worst-case condition (damaged internal joint and seized lugs) until further proof is provided.
